when
Description
Used to specify an event in an iRule. All BIG-IP 9.X iRules begin with
a
when
command. You can specify multiple
when
commands within
a single iRule.
Syntax

<
event_name
>
[
timing
on
|
off
]
[
priority
N

when <event_name>
Used to specify an event in an iRule.
timing
and
priority
are
optional parameters which can enable|disable timing and set the
priority for the declared event.
